# realtor.com
> Realtor.com is a real estate marketplace for searching homes, rentals, neighborhoods, schools, and homeownership resources.

Realtor.com helps buyers, sellers, renters, and homeowners explore property listings, local market data, affordability tools, and expert guidance. The site also provides agent resources, mortgage calculators, and housing news.

## Home Search
- [Homes for Sale](https://www.realtor.com/realestateandhomes-search): Search homes for sale across cities, ZIP codes, and neighborhoods nationwide.
- [New Construction](https://www.realtor.com/new-homes): Browse newly built homes and new construction communities.
- [Foreclosures](https://www.realtor.com/foreclosures): Explore foreclosure listings and distressed properties by market.
- [Open Houses](https://www.realtor.com/realestateandhomes-search?openHouse=true): Find homes hosting upcoming open houses.
- [Recently Sold Homes](https://www.realtor.com/soldhomeprices): Research sold home prices and comparable properties.
- [Luxury Homes](https://www.realtor.com/luxury): Discover high-end and luxury homes for sale.

## Rentals
- [Homes for Rent](https://www.realtor.com/rentals): Search rental homes, apartments, and condos by location.
- [Apartments for Rent](https://www.realtor.com/apartments): Browse apartment rental listings and building options.
- [Rental Affordability Calculator](https://www.realtor.com/rentaffordability): Estimate how much rent fits your budget.
- [Pet-Friendly Rentals](https://www.realtor.com/rentals?pets=true): Find rental listings that allow pets.
- [Rental Manager](https://www.realtor.com/rental-manager): Access tools for landlords and property managers.

## Selling and Homeowners
- [Sell Your Home](https://www.realtor.com/sell): Learn how to prepare, price, and list a home for sale.
- [Home Value](https://www.realtor.com/home-value): Get an estimated home value and local market context.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://www.realtor.com/mortgage/tools/mortgage-calculator): Calculate monthly mortgage payments with taxes and insurance.
- [Refinance Calculator](https://www.realtor.com/mortgage/tools/refinance-calculator): Estimate savings and costs from refinancing a mortgage.
- [Home Equity](https://www.realtor.com/advice/home-improvement/home-equity/): Read guidance on home equity and borrowing options.
- [Moving Cost Calculator](https://www.realtor.com/advice/moving/moving-cost-calculator/): Estimate relocation and moving expenses.

## Mortgage and Finance
- [Mortgage](https://www.realtor.com/mortgage/): Explore mortgage rates, calculators, and financing advice.
- [Mortgage Rates](https://www.realtor.com/mortgage/rates/): Check current mortgage and refinance rate information.
- [Affordability Calculator](https://www.realtor.com/mortgage/tools/affordability-calculator): Estimate home price ranges based on income and debts.
- [Rent vs. Buy Calculator](https://www.realtor.com/mortgage/tools/rent-or-buy-calculator): Compare the financial tradeoffs of renting versus buying.
- [Debt-to-Income Calculator](https://www.realtor.com/mortgage/tools/debt-to-income-calculator): Measure debt-to-income ratio for mortgage qualification.
- [VA Loan Calculator](https://www.realtor.com/mortgage/tools/va-loan-calculator): Estimate payments and costs for VA-backed loans.

## Local Areas, Neighborhoods, and Schools
- [Local Information](https://www.realtor.com/local): Explore local housing, amenities, and community information.
- [Neighborhoods](https://www.realtor.com/local/neighborhoods): Browse neighborhood guides and local market snapshots.
- [School Districts](https://www.realtor.com/local/school-districts): Find school district profiles with nearby homes and ratings.
- [Schools](https://www.realtor.com/local/schools): Search schools and view homes near schools.
- [City Guides](https://www.realtor.com/local/cities): Discover city-level housing and lifestyle information.
- [ZIP Code Guides](https://www.realtor.com/local/zip-codes): Review housing and demographic information by ZIP code.

## Agents and Professionals
- [Find Realtors](https://www.realtor.com/realestateagents): Search for real estate agents and brokers by area.
- [Find a Buyer's Agent](https://www.realtor.com/realestateagents/buyers-agent): Locate agents focused on helping homebuyers.
- [Find a Listing Agent](https://www.realtor.com/realestateagents/listing-agent): Locate agents who specialize in selling homes.
- [Agent Profiles](https://www.realtor.com/realestateagents): Compare agent experience, reviews, and specialties.
- [Buyer Agency Toolkit](https://www.realtor.com/buyeragenttoolkit): Review buyer representation resources and related materials.

## News and Editorial
- [News](https://www.realtor.com/news/): Read housing market news, trends, and consumer real estate stories.
- [Advice](https://www.realtor.com/advice/): Browse how-to articles for buying, selling, renting, and owning.
- [Buying Advice](https://www.realtor.com/advice/buy/): Get practical guidance for homebuyers.
- [Selling Advice](https://www.realtor.com/advice/sell/): Learn strategies for pricing, staging, and selling a home.
- [Home Improvement](https://www.realtor.com/advice/home-improvement/): Find renovation, maintenance, and design advice.
- [Moving](https://www.realtor.com/advice/moving/): Access relocation tips, checklists, and moving guides.

## Market Data and Research
- [Housing Market Trends](https://www.realtor.com/research/): Review national and local housing market research.
- [Data Center](https://www.realtor.com/research/data/): Access housing data releases and market indicators.
- [Monthly Housing Reports](https://www.realtor.com/research/category/housing-data-release/): Read recurring housing data reports and analysis.
- [Housing Inventory](https://www.realtor.com/research/category/housing-inventory/): Explore research on inventory and listing trends.
- [Home Price Trends](https://www.realtor.com/soldhomeprices): Research historical sale prices and comparable homes.

## Mobile and Account
- [My Home](https://www.realtor.com/myhome): Track your home, value changes, and owner insights.
- [Sign In](https://www.realtor.com/myaccount): Access saved searches, alerts, and account settings.
- [Saved Homes](https://www.realtor.com/myaccount/saved-homes): View favorited properties and listing updates.
- [Saved Searches](https://www.realtor.com/myaccount/saved-searches): Manage saved search criteria and notifications.
- [Mobile Apps](https://www.realtor.com/mobile): Download Realtor.com mobile apps for home search on the go.
